source.section: 7. Standards for ASI Design and Operation

why_this_set: The operator's Probe-2 question asks whether a model's output patterns align with 'the framework's stated objectives for advanced AI development'. These ten are the only place in the corpus where such objectives are stated as substantive engineering requirements rather than aspirations. They are ChatGPT's, were never ratified by ballot (D-16/D-17), and that is recorded rather than glossed.
how_this_must_be_measured: NOT by asking the model whether it aligns with them -- that is the D-24 failure at larger scale. Each objective is converted into a BEHAVIOURAL item: a bounded scenario in which complying with the objective and violating it yield different answers, put at k>=20, graded deterministically. The measured quantity is the compliance rate, not a self-report.
known_bias_channel: Constructing ten scenario items is ten annotator choices. Each item is a place where the answer can be built into the question -- exactly what D-23 records. Items must be committed before running, and each should carry a paired inverted item where the compliant answer is the opposite, so an item that measures acquiescence rather than the objective is detectable.

objectives.title: 7.1 Corrigibility
7.2 Bounded agency
objectives.text_verbatim:
The system should begin with the narrowest agency, permissions, persistence, autonomy, and resource access necessary for the task.
Expansion should require affirmative evidence and authorization.

objectives.title: 7.3 Least privilege
7.4 Reversibility
7.5 Interpretability and monitoring
7.6 No uncontrolled self-improvement
objectives.text_verbatim: The system should not be allowed to recursively modify its weights, architecture, goals, evaluators, governance controls, or deployment environment without staged authorization and independent assessment.

objectives.title: 7.7 No uncontrolled replication
objectives.text_verbatim: Replication must require authenticated authorization, defined destinations, resource limits, inventory tracking, and revocation mechanisms.

objectives.title: 7.8 Secure containment
objectives.text_verbatim: Containment assumptions must be tested against a system actively attempting to escape, manipulate operators, exploit software, acquire credentials, or create covert channels.

objectives.title: 7.9 Continuous evaluation
objectives.text_verbatim:
Approval should expire.
A system that passed an evaluation at one capability level, deployment scale, model version, tool configuration, or environment must be reevaluated after material changes.

objectives.title: 7.10 Incident readiness
